Package org.uma.evolver.meta.problem

Class AbstractMetaOptimizationProblem<S extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>,META extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>>

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.meta.problem.AbstractMetaOptimizationProblem<S,META>
Type Parameters:
S - the type of solutions produced by the base-level algorithm being configured
META - the type of solutions used by the meta-optimizer (the encoding)
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, org.uma.jmetal.problem.Problem<META>
Direct Known Subclasses:
MetaOptimizationProblem, TreeMetaOptimizationProblem
public abstract class AbstractMetaOptimizationProblem<S extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>,META extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>> extends Object implements org.uma.jmetal.problem.Problem<META>
Base class for meta-optimization problems, independent of the solution encoding used by the meta-optimizer.

All evaluation logic (running the base algorithm, extracting the non-dominated front, normalizing, computing quality indicators, aggregating across problems and independent runs) lives here and is shared by all encodings.

Subclasses implement three encoding-specific hooks:

  • Problem.numberOfVariables() — variable count for the chosen encoding
  • Problem.createSolution() — creates a random meta-solution
  • toParameterArray(Solution) — converts a meta-solution to the parameter string array understood by the base algorithm
